description: Detects writing style violations and AI tropes

hooks.command: in=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qiE '(step|phase|part).{0,8}[0-9]|[0-9]\.( |\\t)'; then printf '%s' "$in" | bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/numbering.ts" write; fi
in=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qiE '(step|phase|part).{0,8}[0-9]|[0-9]\.( |\\t)'; then printf '%s' "$in" | bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/numbering.ts" edit; fi
in=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qE -- '--(body|message|description|title)[-= ]'; then printf '%s' "$in" | bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/check-tropes.ts"; fi
